name: God-Eternal
description: A one-armed, bird-headed God-Eternal that attacks the ritual and is burned to nothing by Niv-Mizzet.

description_citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Operation Desperation activates and Niv-Mizzet's bones ignite; the light draws a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: it had attracted the attention of one of the God-Eternals

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields all seventeen from the God-Eternal's fist until the ritual completes, then collapses.
timeline.quote: Teyo reached up with both hands and manifested a half sphere of light that covered all seventeen of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet severs the God-Eternal's fist and burns it away with his breath.
timeline.quote: An unending torrent of flame engulfed the God-Eternal

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.
